strings.name: James A. Robinson
strings.summary: Born in Britain and educated at LSE, Warwick and Yale, Robinson combines economics, politics and international fieldwork to study development differences. With Acemoglu and others he examines institutions and prosperity, coauthoring Why Nations Fail and The Narrow Corridor. He shared the 2024 economics Nobel with Acemoglu and Johnson; institutional explanations remain debated.
